Partners

TraceSeis partners with select industry leaders to deliver comprehensive Geoscience Solutions

Geophysical Insights. Advanced analytics and machine learning applications for subsurface interpretation. TraceSeis relies on Paradise, Geophysical Insights application, to provide Machine Learning Lithofacies Prediction – a fast and economic alternative to reservoir characterization.

Z-Terra. Leading provider of integrated enterprise seismic imaging software and processing services for the global upstream oil and gas industry. Z-Terra’s advanced imaging suite includes Kirchhoff PSTM/PSDM, Tomography, Fast Beam Migration, Wave-Equation Migrations (SPM, RTM), 5-D Interpolation, Diffraction Imaging, and Modeling and Illumination—all designed to create high-resolution subsurface images that reveal complex structural and stratigraphic detail.

NMR Petrophysics. Specialized in petrophysical and mineralogical evaluations, shale analysis, producibility prediction, and estimates of relative flow rates for water, oil, and gas. Additional services include petrophysical data management, consistent and reliable net pay tabulation, data editing, and generation of synthetic curves including RHOB and DT.

BRT Energy Advisors. Services:  Prospect Generation, Independent Evaluation of Prospects and Assets, Business Development, Commercialization, New Multiclient Projects and Products, Training
